title: Israeli attacks kill four in Gaza, including a child, as ceasefire toll passes 1,600
detail: Israeli fire killed at least four Palestinians on Nov 5: Abdul Rahim Walid Matar (27) died when a drone fired two missiles at a tent sheltering displaced people west of az-Zawayda in Deir el-Balah; a child was killed in Bureij refugee camp; a woman was shot outside Israeli-controlled areas in Khan Younis; and another person died in a drone strike at Az-zawaya. Drone strikes also wounded several people in al-Baraka and Al-Karama. Gaza's Health Ministry reports 1,602 killed and 5,794 wounded since the Oct 11, 2025 ceasefire, and 74,618 killed and 175,920 wounded since Oct 2023. No IDF statement was included in the report.

media.caption: Palestinians carry the body of Abdelrahim Matar, killed in a drone strike on a tent in Deir el-Balah
